title: introduce-offline-migration-planner-and-terraform-state-verify
author: Aisha K. Patel
description: Context: Private deployments need safer upgrade paths that work in air-gapped environments and with operator-managed Terraform state. This PR adds an offline migration planner (CLI) and a Terraform state verification step to the installer to reduce rollback blast radius and make post-upgrade verification deterministic. Motivation: Operators have asked for a reproducible, reviewable migration plan that can be generated without cluster access (for change boards) plus a verification step that validates the target infrastructure state matches the expected release manifest before the helm release proceeds. Summary of changes (high level): 1) migration/planner: new CLI tool 'rwi-migrate-plan' that produces a compact plan artifact (JSON + SHA256) describing upgrade steps, DB migration sequence, expected CRD/CR changes, and a dry-run summary. The planner can run against manifests only (offline) or against a live cluster. 2) installer/terraform: terraform verify hook added that compares remote terraform state (when reachable) or local plan file against the release lockfile; it fails-fast on drift > 0.1% of resources (configurable). 3) helm: pre-upgrade hook to store a 'release-lock' ConfigMap with release hash and allowed-rollback flag; operator flows set allowed-rollback=false by default for major schema changes. 4) migrations: migration manifests now include a step-level 'check' command and an idempotency token so retries are safe. 5) tests: added unit tests for planner serialization and an integration smoke test that validates a blueprint upgrade from v1.4.3 -> v1.5.0 in CI Docker environment. Checklist: - [x] CLI planner implementation and help docs - [x] Terraform verify module + config flag - [x] Helm release-lock pre-upgrade hook - [x] Migration step idempotency tokens - [x] Unit tests and lightweight CI integration - [x] Linear references and internal docs Updates/commits (summary): - commit 1: add migration planner binary + docs + example plan export - commit 2: terraform: add verify module, config option 'terraform_verify_threshold' - commit 3: helm: release-lock ConfigMap and pre-upgrade hook, update templates - commit 4: installer: wire up planner as optional preflight step and add CLI flags - commit 5: tests: add planner unit tests and integration smoke harness Files changed (high level): - migration/planner/* (new files): main.go, plan.go, serializer.go, README.md - installer/cmd/preflight.go: call planner when --dry-plan specified - terraform/modules/verify/main.tf: new module for state comparison - helm/charts/redwood/templates/release-lock-configmap.yaml: new template - charts/templates/hooks/pre-upgrade-release-lock.yaml: new hook - migrations/*.yaml: added 'idempotency_token' and 'check' fields - test/integration/smoke/blueprint-upgrade.sh: new CI smoke script Example snippet (planner export skeleton): '{"plan_version":"1","steps":[{"id":"db-001","kind":"migration","desc":"add index to kv_store","checksum":"sha256:...","check":"/bin/psql -c \"SELECT 1\""}]}' Review conversation (high level): - Reviewer Kenji Matsuo: requested clearer failure messaging when terraform state endpoint times out; asked for a knob to opt out of remote state checks in air-gapped installs. - Author (Aisha): added --skip-remote-state and improved logs per request; updated docs to emphasize offline plan workflow. - Reviewer Marta Lopez: asked for an explicit note on how release-lock interacts with automatic rollbacks; author clarified that override requires an operator flag and audit entry. - Review turns: 3 rounds; final approvals from Kenji and Marta. CI and checks: - CI: rwi-unit-tests (pass) - CI: rwi-integration-smoke (flaky on initial run, rerun and pass) - Lint: gofmt + staticcheck (pass) - Security scan: Snyk (pass) - TerraTest: terraform-verify module tests (pass) Metrics captured in PR: files_changed_count=18, additions=1246, deletions=347; most changes are new files and test fixtures Release notes: - Added 'rwi-migrate-plan' offline migration planner to generate reviewable upgrade plans - Terraform verifier module will detect drift and block upgrades when specified threshold exceeded - Helm will create a release-lock ConfigMap to gate automatic rollback behavior Breaking change: false Backport/upgrade plan: Not required for patch releases. Operators upgrading to 1.5 should: 1) run rwi-migrate-plan --export plan-v1.5.json and have the change board sign-off, 2) run installer with --terraform-verify (or --skip-remote-state in air-gapped), 3) observe release-lock behavior in preflight and toggle allowed-rollback if necessary Linear links: ENG-4827, ENG-4899, PM-1038 Related tickets: SUP-9876 (customer report: accidental rollback after schema migration) Merge outcome: Squash and merge; commit message standardized to include plan SHA and Linear IDs: "rwi: add offline migration planner + terraform verify (ENG-4827, ENG-4899)"
release_notes: Add offline migration planner (rwi-migrate-plan), terraform verify hook that detects drift, and a helm release-lock to make rollback behavior explicit.
